# vscode-golang-gherkingen

> VS Code extension that generates Behaviour Driven Development (BDD) Go test
> boilerplate from Cucumber/Gherkin `*.feature` files by running the
> [gherkingen](https://github.com/hedhyw/gherkingen) generator in a Docker
> container.

The extension contributes one command, `golang-gherkingen.generate`
("Go: Generate BDD Golang test"). It pulls the `hedhyw/gherkingen` Docker
image, mounts the active feature file read-only into a network-less
container, and opens the generated Go test in a new editor. Rootless Docker
is required at runtime. The optional `golang-gherkingen.feature.language`
setting selects the natural language of the feature file.
